original.scope_and_content: Autor: Sprecher/Sprecherinnen: Burkhalter, Didier; Steiert, Jean-François;

classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim video recording of a debate in the National Council, created at the time of the event by the Council.
classification.resume: The document is a parliamentary motion concerning the dispensing of medicines by doctors, proposing to reduce profit margins and compensate for any income losses if necessary. It was presented during a session of the National Council in April 2011 and recorded as a video of the debate. The motion was authored by the Social Democratic parliamentary group.
